mapper.select: SELECT P.PRGRM_INTRD_SN AS PROGRAM_ID, P.PRGRM_CTGRY_CD AS CATEGORY_CODE, C.CD_DTL_NM AS CATEGORY_NAME, P.PRGRM_TTL AS TITLE, P.PRGRM_EXPLN AS DESCRIPTION, P.PLC_CN AS PLACE, P.OPRTN_PD_CN AS PERIOD, P.NOPE_CN AS CAPACITY, P.APLY_URL_ADDR AS APPLY_URL, ( SELECT F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = P.IMG_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS THUMBNAIL_URL FROM EDU_PRGRM_INTRD P LEFT JOIN CMMN_CD_DTL C ON C.CD_ID = 'COM048' AND C.CD_DTL_ID = P.PRGRM_CTGRY_CD WHERE P.DEL_YN = 'N' AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY P.SORT_SEQ ASC, P.PRGRM_INTRD_SN ASC

SELECT C.CD_DTL_ID AS CATEGORY_CODE, C.CD_DTL_NM AS CATEGORY_NAME FROM CMMN_CD_DTL C WHERE C.CD_ID = 'COM048' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EDU_PRGRM_INTRD P WHERE P.PRGRM_CTGRY_CD = C.CD_DTL_ID AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ) ORDER BY C.SORT_SEQ ASC
